title: Creamy Thai Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic pilaf dish with a creamy twist, inspired by Thai cuisine.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 cup of Thai rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add 1 teaspoon of pilaf seasoning and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and stir in 1/2 cup of shredded cheese.
Add 1/4 cup of oozy sauce and stir to combine.
Optional: garnish with additional cheese and pilaf seasoning, if desired.
